name: BIT 4484 Notes 7 19 2020
excerpt: BIT 4484 Notes 7 19 2020 covers essential project planning concepts.
notes:
Planning Projects pt1

Planning Projects

Purpose - Guides project execution 

Should be realistic and useful

Project Integration Management - Knowledge area that involves coordinating all the project knowledge areas throughout a project’s lifespan

Project Management Plan - Document used to integrate all other project documents and guide execution, monitoring and control

Facilitates communication among stakeholders

Serves as a baseline for measurement and control

A starting point to reference for future comparison

Should be dynamic and flexible

Project Scope Management - Determines how scope will be defined, validated, and controlled

Verification - Deliverable complies with given requirements and specifications

Quality Control

Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) - Table that lists requirements and various attributes on how close we are to meeting those requirements

Validation - Formal acceptance of the deliverables by the customers and other stakeholders

Defining Scope - Exactly what the project is expected to accomplish

May need to be updated as project progresses

Scope Creep - Scope becoming larger as project continues

Avoiding Scope Creep

Know project

Document Requirements

Change Control Processes

Avoid Gold Plating - Always wanting to make things just a liiiiiitttle bit better

Work Breakdown Structure - Deliverable-oriented grouping of the work involved in a project that defines the total scope of the project.

Breaks down all work into discrete tasks

Work Package - Deliverable at the lowest level of the WBS

100% of all deliverables should be included in WBS

Graphical Form

Entire project in Level 1

Main Groupings in Level 2

Smaller groupings further down

All blocks are nouns which is cool i guess



Tabular form

Same information, presented in a list

A good WBS is Mutually Exclusive Completely Exhaustive
